author: TeIq
content: **Pre-flight (architect, rust-quality applied).** No existing click-to-reveal/iframe-sandbox component on disk. Ship two pieces: (1) polaris-frontend/src/components/safe_payload.rs — SafePayload component: by default renders a click-to-reveal placeholder; on click reveals content as text (no innerHTML) with explicit guards against auto-load. Embedded URLs that look like images render as text URLs only (no tag), iframes if any are rendered as sandboxed (sandbox='' = strict). (2) polaris-frontend/tests/safe_payload_t5.rs wasm-bindgen-test asserting the three properties. Pure-function predicates extracted as in #54.
